title: ۵ جمله‌ای که هر ناخن‌کار هر روز می‌شنوه
goal: Shareable 'tag your nail artist' reel. Target 28-38 s total. Strong 1-second hook, one gag per scene, wholesome payoff, loop back to scene 1 pose.

cast.name: Nailie
cast.desc: round pink blob, tiny nail-brush antenna with a gel-drop tip, big glossy eyes, calm and patient, long glossy almond-nail hands in close-ups

cast.name: Client
cast.desc: round peach-cream blob with a small bottle-cap tuft on top, very expressive brows, always smiling politely while asking for impossible things

scenes.text: ۵ جمله‌ای که هر ناخن‌کار هر روز می‌شنوه
scenes.idea: Hook, must grab in 1 s: Nailie sits at her tiny table, nail lamp glowing; Client blob bounces in; a giant hand-drawn number 5 smashes into frame with squash and sparkle trails over glossy nails. Fast push-in, confetti-less, bright and cute.
scenes.say: پنج جمله‌ای که هر ناخن‌کار هر روز می‌شنوه

scenes.text: میگه یه کم کوتاهش کن... یعنی سه سانت!
scenes.idea: Client pinches fingers 'just a tiny bit'. Cut to Nailie's thought bubble: a giant ruler measures a long nail, the 'tiny bit' stretches to three centimeters, nail clippings pile up like a mountain. Nailie's eyes widen, antenna droops.

scenes.text: میگه طرح ساده می‌خوام... یعنی گل، نگین، فرنچ و خط طلایی
scenes.idea: Client: 'simple!' with a calm smile. Thought bubble list pops item by item (flower, gems, french tip, gold line), every item pops with a ding and the nail design gets absurdly busy; Nailie's brush antenna spins like a helicopter.

scenes.text: میگه عجله ندارم... ده دقیقه بعد: تموم نشد؟
scenes.idea: Client relaxed on a cushion with a drink: 'no rush'. Fast clock montage (clock hands spin, sun to moon), Client suddenly checks a tiny watch and panics, Nailie's gel lamp timer ticks, steam from Nailie.

scenes.text: میگه عین عکس بزن... عکسی که فیلتر خورده!
scenes.idea: Client holds up a phone: nails are glittering 3D crystals with impossible sparkles and a sparkle filter. Nailie compares the photo and her real nail, her jaw drops; magnifier zoom, 'filter' sparkles rain.

scenes.text: میگه هر چی خودت صلاح می‌دونی... نه نه اون رنگ نه!
scenes.idea: Client gives a thumbs up: 'your choice!'. Nailie happily picks a color; Client freezes, eyes shrink, waves both hands in panic, color swatches fly by like cards; Nailie slumps comically.

scenes.text: ولی وقتی ناخن‌ها تموم می‌شه... وای عاشقشونم!
scenes.idea: Warm light sweeps in; glossy finished nails fill the frame in macro with a specular sweep and sparkles; Client's eyes become hearts and hugs the air; Nailie melts into a happy puddle, all the earlier chaos forgotten; hearts float.

Nailie winks at the viewer and points at a share arrow; Client sneaks in from the side, pinches fingers 'just a little' again for the loop gag; end with the same pose as scene 1 for a seamless loop; then end-card with @ayda.nailroom.
